answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable bond before trading, released only after honest activity. Each identity must periodically solve a fresh cipher challenge signed with its registered key, proving it controls the same bonded account instead of spawning new shells. A regular activity pulse, recorded in a clear crystal ledger, verifies the account remains active and unique. Faking thousands of identities means locking thousands of separate bonds and maintaining each one, so an attacker's cost rises linearly with every fake, while an honest agent pays only once.
